doctrine: Bryce Jones: Tuskegee HBCU engineer (2019), cast-on entry into photography April 2019. Seven-year craft development journey (2019-2026) with ZERO business traction until late 2025. Mechanical engineering base + City/Regional Planning grad school (Clemson 2019). Mentor: Larry Bernard (May 2019 onwards). Financial foundation: Serverfarm field engineering, $102K remote, 1-2 travel days/month (Monday-Friday). Living at Pearl's parents' duplex Eagle Rock, no rent. Debt foundation: $40,600 across NF Personal ($367/mo)/NF Business ($625/mo)/Amex ($290/mo)/Zales ($100/mo)/IRS ($231/mo)/Best Buy+Mom ($120/mo)/Adidas ($49/mo) + Acima/Snap auto debt ($1,978 due May 27). Basketball ref income ($30/hr, Jan-Mar, Eagle Rock/Hermosa/Manhattan Beach inefficient). First real revenue signal: Jan-Mar 2026 ($250/mo average, first 3 consecutive months). Direction Stack: 57-page book, 10 protocols, codified from 7 years of subject directing (tension/posture/hands/shoulders). Not published. Rejuar Rahman (Upwork, $100/mo retainer) = designer/editor. Jamie's Vibrant Eye Studios DTLA = informal shoot space. Strongest case study: Davis Law Group (July 2025). Celebrity BTS shoot (Dec 2025) got featured over main photographer but no credit (BTS only). First engagement catch (beach proposal, Jan 2026 New Year's Day). Major work: Nubian x Joi brand campaign, Church of God in Christ (Emmanuel 33rd + Bishop Peters Elevation Banquet June 27), Miho/Sasha headshots + dance-studio parent network pipeline incoming. Gear: Canon EOS RP (overused, battery issues), lenses (24mm/50mm/85mm/24-105mm/70-200mm/8mm fisheye), 2x Godox 40W continuous (DC only), 5-6 batteries, MacBook M4 Pro. Core statement: 'I'm starting from zero. 7 years of craft but zero business traction. Nothing worked for 7 years except developing the craft. I don't give a damn what I was doing in the past. That shit didn't work.' Energy pattern: peaks morning/afternoon, needs to be free by 7pm (Pearl). Drains: fragmentation, lack of connection between pieces, busy work. Peak: making money + telling stories, name recognition, museum work, THE photographer identity. Turkey March-April 2026 (hair transplant + Grand Bazaar, 60-day camera break). Sister financial support starting August.
